import math

enum Mode
    RNE
    RNA
    RTZ
    RUP
    RDN

enum Special
    PositiveInfinity
    NegativeInfinity
    NaN

class Exact(int n, exponent := 0, d := 1, negative := false)

class Ratio(int n, int d)

class Bounds(int minimum, int maximum)

class Fields(bool negative, int exponent, int fraction, int q)

class Flags(invalid := false, divbyzero := false, overflow := false, underflow := false, inexact := false)

class Result(int pattern, flags := Flags())

class Units(int value, bool inexact)

class Format(string name, int e, int m)
    width := 1 + e + m
    bias := 2 ^ (e - 1) - 1
    emin := 1 - bias
    emax := bias
    hidden := 2 ^ m
    exponent_mask := 2 ^ e - 1
    sign_bit := 2 ^ (e + m)
    infinity := exponent_mask * hidden
    nan_pattern := infinity + hidden / 2
    maximum := infinity - 1

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

Flags combined(const Flags left, const Flags right)
    return Flags(left.invalid or right.invalid, left.divbyzero or right.divbyzero, left.overflow or right.overflow, left.underflow or right.underflow, left.inexact or right.inexact)

string flag_text(const Flags flags)
    string[] names := []
    if flags.invalid
        names = names.append("invalid")
    if flags.divbyzero
        names = names.append("divbyzero")
    if flags.overflow
        names = names.append("overflow")
    if flags.underflow
        names = names.append("underflow")
    if flags.inexact
        names = names.append("inexact")
    return "flags=" + (if #names == 0 then "none" else names.join(","))

Mode | error parse_mode(string word)
    if word == "RNE"
        return Mode.RNE
    if word == "RNA"
        return Mode.RNA
    if word == "RTZ"
        return Mode.RTZ
    if word == "RUP"
        return Mode.RUP
    if word == "RDN"
        return Mode.RDN
    return error("BAD MODE {word}")

Mode | error optional_mode(const string[] words, int position)
    if position < int(#words)
        return try parse_mode(words[position])
    return Mode.RNE

string mode_text(Mode mode)
    return if mode == Mode.RNE then "RNE" elif mode == Mode.RNA then "RNA" elif mode == Mode.RTZ then "RTZ" elif mode == Mode.RUP then "RUP" else "RDN"

string special_text(Special special)
    return if special == Special.NaN then "nan" elif special == Special.NegativeInfinity then "-inf" else "inf"

int gcd(int left, int right)
    while right != 0
        left, right = right, left % right
    return left

Ratio scaled(const Exact exact, int unit_exponent)
    shift := exact.exponent - unit_exponent
    if shift >= 0
        return Ratio(exact.n * 2 ^ shift, exact.d)
    return Ratio(exact.n, exact.d * 2 ^ (-shift))

Exact negated(Exact exact)
    exact.negative = not exact.negative
    return exact

Exact product(const Exact left, const Exact right)
    return Exact(left.n * right.n, left.exponent + right.exponent, left.d * right.d, left.negative != right.negative)

Exact exact_sum(const Exact[] terms, Mode mode)
    nonzero := [for term := terms[] if term.n != 0 then term]
    if #nonzero == 0
        same := true
        for term := terms[]
            if term.negative != terms[0].negative
                same = false
        return Exact(0, negative = if same then terms[0].negative else mode == Mode.RDN)
    exponent := [for term := nonzero[] then term.exponent].min()
    aligned := [for term := nonzero[] then (if term.negative then -1 else 1) * term.n * 2 ^ (term.exponent - exponent)]
    total := aligned.sum()
    return Exact(math.abs(total), exponent, negative = if total == 0 then mode == Mode.RDN else total < 0)

string fraction_text(const Exact exact)
    if exact.n == 0
        return "0"
    ratio := scaled(exact, 0)
    factor := gcd(ratio.n, ratio.d)
    numerator := ratio.n / factor
    denominator := ratio.d / factor
    sign := if exact.negative then "-" else ""
    return sign + string(numerator) + (if denominator == 1 then "" else "/{denominator}")

string decimal_text(const Exact exact, keep_zero_sign := false)
    ratio := scaled(exact, 0)
    text := string(ratio.n / ratio.d)
    remainder := ratio.n % ratio.d
    if remainder != 0
        text += "."
        while remainder != 0
            remainder *= 10
            text += string(remainder / ratio.d)
            remainder %= ratio.d
    if exact.negative and (exact.n != 0 or keep_zero_sign)
        text = "-" + text
    return text

int binary_order(int value)
    order := -1
    while value > 0
        value /= 2
        order += 1
    return order

int log_floor(const Exact exact)
    order := binary_order(exact.n) - binary_order(exact.d) + exact.exponent
    ratio := scaled(exact, order)
    return order - (if ratio.n < ratio.d then 1 else 0)

int integer_sqrt(int value)
    if value == 0
        return 0
    root := 1
    while root * root <= value
        root *= 2
    while true
        next := (root + value / root) / 2
        if next >= root
            return root
        root = next

bool increment(Mode mode, bool negative, int integer, bool inexact, int midpoint)
    if not inexact
        return false
    if mode == Mode.RNE
        return midpoint > 0 or midpoint == 0 and integer % 2 == 1
    if mode == Mode.RNA
        return midpoint >= 0
    if mode == Mode.RUP
        return not negative
    return mode == Mode.RDN and negative

Units round_units(const Exact exact, int unit_exponent, Mode mode, square_root := false)
    ratio := scaled(exact, if square_root then 2 * unit_exponent else unit_exponent)
    int integer
    bool inexact
    int midpoint
    if square_root
        integer = integer_sqrt(ratio.n / ratio.d)
        inexact = integer * integer * ratio.d != ratio.n
        midpoint = 4 * ratio.n - ratio.d * (2 * integer + 1) ^ 2
    else
        integer = ratio.n / ratio.d
        remainder := ratio.n % ratio.d
        inexact = remainder != 0
        midpoint = 2 * remainder - ratio.d
    if increment(mode, exact.negative, integer, inexact, midpoint)
        integer += 1
    return Units(integer, inexact)

Fields decode_fields(const Format fmt, int pattern)
    exponent := pattern / fmt.hidden % (fmt.exponent_mask + 1)
    fraction := pattern % fmt.hidden
    q := (if exponent == 0 then fmt.emin else exponent - fmt.bias) - fmt.m
    return Fields(pattern >= fmt.sign_bit, exponent, fraction, q)

bool is_nan(const Format fmt, int pattern)
    parts := decode_fields(fmt, pattern)
    return parts.exponent == fmt.exponent_mask and parts.fraction != 0

bool is_signaling(const Format fmt, int pattern)
    return is_nan(fmt, pattern) and pattern % fmt.hidden < fmt.hidden / 2

bool is_infinity(const Format fmt, int pattern)
    return pattern % fmt.sign_bit == fmt.infinity

bool is_zero(const Format fmt, int pattern)
    return pattern % fmt.sign_bit == 0

bool is_finite(const Format fmt, int pattern)
    return decode_fields(fmt, pattern).exponent != fmt.exponent_mask

int zero_pattern(const Format fmt, bool negative)
    return if negative then fmt.sign_bit else 0

int infinity_pattern(const Format fmt, bool negative)
    return zero_pattern(fmt, negative) + fmt.infinity

int flip(const Format fmt, int pattern)
    return if pattern >= fmt.sign_bit then pattern - fmt.sign_bit else pattern + fmt.sign_bit

Exact from_pattern(const Format fmt, int pattern)
    parts := decode_fields(fmt, pattern)
    significand := parts.fraction + (if parts.exponent == 0 then 0 else fmt.hidden)
    return Exact(significand, parts.q, negative = parts.negative)

Result overflow_result(const Format fmt, Mode mode, bool negative)
    infinite := mode == Mode.RNE or mode == Mode.RNA or mode == Mode.RUP and not negative or mode == Mode.RDN and negative
    pattern := zero_pattern(fmt, negative) + (if infinite then fmt.infinity else fmt.maximum)
    return Result(pattern, Flags(overflow = true, inexact = true))

Result rounded(const Format fmt, const Exact exact, Mode mode, square_root := false)
    if exact.n == 0
        return Result(zero_pattern(fmt, exact.negative))
    order := log_floor(exact)
    if square_root
        order = if order >= 0 then order / 2 else -((-order + 1) / 2)
    if order > fmt.emax
        return overflow_result(fmt, mode, exact.negative)
    exponent := math.max(order, fmt.emin) - fmt.m
    units := round_units(exact, exponent, mode, square_root)
    significand := units.value
    if significand == 2 * fmt.hidden
        significand = fmt.hidden
        exponent += 1
    if exponent > fmt.emax - fmt.m
        return overflow_result(fmt, mode, exact.negative)
    magnitude := if significand >= fmt.hidden then (exponent + fmt.m + fmt.bias) * fmt.hidden + significand - fmt.hidden else significand
    underflow := false
    if units.inexact and order < fmt.emin
        underflow = true
        if order == fmt.emin - 1
            unbounded := round_units(exact, order - fmt.m, mode, square_root)
            underflow = unbounded.value < 2 * fmt.hidden
    return Result(zero_pattern(fmt, exact.negative) + magnitude, Flags(underflow = underflow, inexact = units.inexact))

int radix_value(string text, int base)
    value := 0
    for code := text.codepoints()[]
        int digit := if code >= 65 then code - 55 else code - 48
        value = value * base + digit
    return value

string radix_text(int value, int base, int width)
    digits := "0123456789ABCDEF"
    text := ""
    for: 0 <= position < width
        text = digits[value % base] + text
        value /= base
    return text

string bit_text(const Format fmt, int pattern)
    parts := decode_fields(fmt, pattern)
    sign := if parts.negative then "1" else "0"
    return sign + "|" + radix_text(parts.exponent, 2, fmt.e) + "|" + radix_text(parts.fraction, 2, fmt.m)

string hex_text(const Format fmt, int pattern)
    return "0x" + radix_text(pattern, 16, (fmt.width + 3) / 4)

string value_text(const Format fmt, int pattern)
    if is_nan(fmt, pattern)
        return "nan"
    if is_infinity(fmt, pattern)
        return if pattern >= fmt.sign_bit then "-inf" else "inf"
    return decimal_text(from_pattern(fmt, pattern), true)

string pattern_text(const Format fmt, int pattern)
    return bit_text(fmt, pattern) + " " + hex_text(fmt, pattern) + " " + value_text(fmt, pattern)

string result_text(const Format fmt, const Result result)
    return pattern_text(fmt, result.pattern) + " " + flag_text(result.flags)

Exact | Special | error parse_real(string word)
    if word == "nan"
        return Special.NaN
    if word == "inf"
        return Special.PositiveInfinity
    if word == "-inf"
        return Special.NegativeInfinity
    if word.starts_with("0b") or word.starts_with("0x")
        return error("BAD OPERAND {word}")
    negative := word.starts_with("-")
    body := if negative then word[1:] else word
    parts := body.split("/")
    if #parts == 2
        numerator := int(parts[0])
        denominator := int(parts[1])
        if denominator == 0
            return error("BAD OPERAND {word}")
        return Exact(numerator, d = denominator, negative = negative)
    parts = body.split(".")
    numerator := int(parts.join(""))
    denominator := if #parts == 2 then 10 ^ int(#parts[1]) else 1
    return Exact(numerator, d = denominator, negative = negative)

Result encoded(const Format fmt, Exact | Special value, Mode mode)
    match value
        Exact exact
            return rounded(fmt, exact, mode)
        Special special
            return Result(if special == Special.NaN then fmt.nan_pattern else infinity_pattern(fmt, special == Special.NegativeInfinity))

int | error operand(const Format fmt, string word)
    if word.starts_with("0b")
        if int(#word) - 2 != fmt.width
            return error("BAD OPERAND {word}")
        return radix_value(word[2:], 2)
    if word.starts_with("0x")
        pattern := radix_value(word[2:], 16)
        if int(#word) - 2 != (fmt.width + 3) / 4 or pattern >= 2 * fmt.sign_bit
            return error("BAD OPERAND {word}")
        return pattern
    Exact | Special value := try parse_real(word)
    return encoded(fmt, value, Mode.RNE).pattern

int[] | error operands(const Format fmt, const string[] words)
    int[] patterns := []
    for word := words[]
        pattern := try operand(fmt, word)
        patterns = patterns.append(pattern)
    return patterns

Result invalid_result(const Format fmt)
    return Result(fmt.nan_pattern, Flags(invalid = true))

Result operation(const Format fmt, string op, const int[] patterns, Mode mode)
    a := patterns[0]
    if op == "SUB"
        return operation(fmt, "ADD", [a, flip(fmt, patterns[1])], mode)
    has_nan := false
    signaling := false
    for pattern := patterns[]
        has_nan = has_nan or is_nan(fmt, pattern)
        signaling = signaling or is_signaling(fmt, pattern)
    if has_nan
        return Result(fmt.nan_pattern, Flags(invalid = signaling))
    if op == "SQRT"
        if is_zero(fmt, a)
            return Result(a)
        if a >= fmt.sign_bit
            return invalid_result(fmt)
        if is_infinity(fmt, a)
            return Result(a)
        return rounded(fmt, from_pattern(fmt, a), mode, true)
    b := patterns[1]
    negative := (a >= fmt.sign_bit) != (b >= fmt.sign_bit)
    if op == "ADD"
        if is_infinity(fmt, a) and is_infinity(fmt, b) and negative
            return invalid_result(fmt)
        if is_infinity(fmt, a)
            return Result(a)
        if is_infinity(fmt, b)
            return Result(b)
        return rounded(fmt, exact_sum([from_pattern(fmt, a), from_pattern(fmt, b)], mode), mode)
    if op == "MUL"
        if is_infinity(fmt, a) or is_infinity(fmt, b)
            return if is_zero(fmt, a) or is_zero(fmt, b) then invalid_result(fmt) else Result(infinity_pattern(fmt, negative))
        if is_zero(fmt, a) or is_zero(fmt, b)
            return Result(zero_pattern(fmt, negative))
        return rounded(fmt, product(from_pattern(fmt, a), from_pattern(fmt, b)), mode)
    if op == "DIV"
        if is_infinity(fmt, a)
            return if is_infinity(fmt, b) then invalid_result(fmt) else Result(infinity_pattern(fmt, negative))
        if is_infinity(fmt, b)
            return Result(zero_pattern(fmt, negative))
        if is_zero(fmt, b)
            return if is_zero(fmt, a) then invalid_result(fmt) else Result(infinity_pattern(fmt, negative), Flags(divbyzero = true))
        if is_zero(fmt, a)
            return Result(zero_pattern(fmt, negative))
        left := from_pattern(fmt, a)
        right := from_pattern(fmt, b)
        return rounded(fmt, Exact(left.n, left.exponent - right.exponent, right.n, negative), mode)
    c := patterns[2]
    if is_infinity(fmt, a) or is_infinity(fmt, b)
        if is_zero(fmt, a) or is_zero(fmt, b) or is_infinity(fmt, c) and (c >= fmt.sign_bit) != negative
            return invalid_result(fmt)
        return Result(infinity_pattern(fmt, negative))
    if is_infinity(fmt, c)
        return Result(c)
    multiplied := product(from_pattern(fmt, a), from_pattern(fmt, b))
    return rounded(fmt, exact_sum([multiplied, from_pattern(fmt, c)], mode), mode)

int next_up(const Format fmt, int pattern)
    if pattern == fmt.infinity
        return pattern
    if is_zero(fmt, pattern)
        return 1
    return pattern + (if pattern >= fmt.sign_bit then -1 else 1)

int order_key(const Format fmt, int pattern)
    return if pattern >= fmt.sign_bit then fmt.sign_bit - pattern - 1 else pattern

string relation(int left, int right)
    return if left < right then "LT" elif left > right then "GT" else "EQ"

string difference(const Format fmt, int pattern, const Exact exact)
    if not is_finite(fmt, pattern)
        return value_text(fmt, pattern)
    return fraction_text(exact_sum([from_pattern(fmt, pattern), negated(exact)], Mode.RNE))

void summary(const Format fmt, Mode mode, const int[] patterns, const Result result)
    exact := exact_sum([for pattern := patterns[] then from_pattern(fmt, pattern)], mode)
    emit("RESULT " + result_text(fmt, result))
    emit("EXACT " + decimal_text(exact))
    emit("ROUNDED " + result_text(fmt, rounded(fmt, exact, mode)))
    emit("DIFF " + difference(fmt, result.pattern, exact))

void | error summation(string op, const Format fmt, Mode mode, const int[] patterns)
    for pattern := patterns[]
        if not is_finite(fmt, pattern)
            return error("NOT FINITE")
    emit("{op} {fmt.name} {mode_text(mode)} count={#patterns}")
    total := patterns[0]
    compensation := 0
    flags := Flags()
    for: 1 <= index < int(#patterns)
        if op == "SUM"
            added := operation(fmt, "ADD", [total, patterns[index]], mode)
            total = added.pattern
            flags = combined(flags, added.flags)
            emit("PARTIAL {index + 1} " + result_text(fmt, added))
        else
            y_value := operation(fmt, "SUB", [patterns[index], compensation], mode)
            t_value := operation(fmt, "ADD", [total, y_value.pattern], mode)
            d_value := operation(fmt, "SUB", [t_value.pattern, total], mode)
            c_value := operation(fmt, "SUB", [d_value.pattern, y_value.pattern], mode)
            total = t_value.pattern
            compensation = c_value.pattern
            step_flags := combined(combined(y_value.flags, t_value.flags), combined(d_value.flags, c_value.flags))
            flags = combined(flags, step_flags)
            emit("KSTEP {index + 1} sum={value_text(fmt, total)} comp={value_text(fmt, compensation)} {flag_text(step_flags)}")
    summary(fmt, mode, patterns, Result(total, flags))
    return void

void | error dot_product(const Format fmt, Mode mode, const int[] left, const int[] right)
    if #left != #right
        return error("LENGTH MISMATCH")
    for pattern := left.concat(right)[]
        if not is_finite(fmt, pattern)
            return error("NOT FINITE")
    naive := operation(fmt, "MUL", [left[0], right[0]], mode)
    chained := naive
    for: 1 <= index < int(#left)
        multiplied := operation(fmt, "MUL", [left[index], right[index]], mode)
        added := operation(fmt, "ADD", [naive.pattern, multiplied.pattern], mode)
        naive = Result(added.pattern, combined(naive.flags, combined(multiplied.flags, added.flags)))
        fused := operation(fmt, "FMA", [left[index], right[index], chained.pattern], mode)
        chained = Result(fused.pattern, combined(chained.flags, fused.flags))
    terms := [for index := left.indices()[] then product(from_pattern(fmt, left[index]), from_pattern(fmt, right[index]))]
    exact := exact_sum(terms, mode)
    emit("DOT {fmt.name} {mode_text(mode)} n={#left}")
    emit("NAIVE " + result_text(fmt, naive))
    emit("CHAINED " + result_text(fmt, chained))
    emit("EXACT " + decimal_text(exact))
    emit("FUSED " + result_text(fmt, rounded(fmt, exact, mode)))
    emit("DIFF naive={difference(fmt, naive.pattern, exact)} chained={difference(fmt, chained.pattern, exact)}")
    return void

void | error table_output(const Format fmt)
    if fmt.width > 8
        return error("TABLE TOO LARGE")
    emit("TABLE {fmt.name} count={fmt.infinity}")
    for: 0 <= pattern < fmt.infinity
        gap := "-"
        if pattern < fmt.maximum
            gap = decimal_text(exact_sum([from_pattern(fmt, pattern + 1), negated(from_pattern(fmt, pattern))], Mode.RNE))
        emit("ENTRY {pattern} {pattern_text(fmt, pattern)} gap={gap}")
    emit("MAX " + pattern_text(fmt, fmt.maximum))
    emit("MINNORMAL " + pattern_text(fmt, fmt.hidden))
    emit("MINSUBNORMAL " + pattern_text(fmt, 1))
    emit("EPSILON " + decimal_text(Exact(1, -fmt.m)))
    emit("PATTERNS finite={2 * fmt.infinity} infinite=2 nan={2 * (fmt.hidden - 1)} total={2 * fmt.sign_bit}")
    return void

Format | error lookup_format(const map<string, Format> formats, string name)
    match formats.get(name)
        Format found
            return found
        none
            return error("UNKNOWN FORMAT {name}")

Bounds | error integer_limits(string name)
    if name == "I8"
        return Bounds(-128, 127)
    if name == "U8"
        return Bounds(0, 255)
    if name == "I16"
        return Bounds(-32768, 32767)
    if name == "U16"
        return Bounds(0, 65535)
    if name == "I32"
        return Bounds(-2147483648, 2147483647)
    if name == "U32"
        return Bounds(0, 4294967295)
    return error("BAD TYPE {name}")

void | error command(map<string, Format> &formats, const string[] words)
    op := words[0]
    name := words[1]
    if op == "FORMAT"
        if formats.has(name)
            return error("FORMAT EXISTS {name}")
        e := int(words[2])
        m := int(words[3])
        if e < 2 or e > 5 or m < 1 or m > 10
            return error("BAD FORMAT")
        added := Format(name, e, m)
        .formats.set(name, added)
        emit("FORMAT {name} e={e} m={m} bits={added.width} bias={added.bias} emin={added.emin} emax={added.emax}")
        return void
    fmt := try lookup_format(formats, name)
    if op == "ENCODE"
        Exact | Special value := try parse_real(words[2])
        mode := try optional_mode(words, 3)
        string text
        match value
            Exact exact
                text = fraction_text(exact)
            Special special
                text = special_text(special)
        emit("ENCODE {name} {mode_text(mode)} {text} " + result_text(fmt, encoded(fmt, value, mode)))
    elif op == "CONVERT"
        destination := try lookup_format(formats, words[2])
        pattern := try operand(fmt, words[3])
        mode := try optional_mode(words, 4)
        Result converted
        if is_nan(fmt, pattern)
            converted = Result(destination.nan_pattern, Flags(invalid = is_signaling(fmt, pattern)))
        elif is_infinity(fmt, pattern)
            converted = Result(infinity_pattern(destination, pattern >= fmt.sign_bit))
        else
            converted = rounded(destination, from_pattern(fmt, pattern), mode)
        emit("CONVERT {name} {destination.name} {mode_text(mode)} " + result_text(destination, converted))
    elif op == "SUM" or op == "KAHAN" or op == "DOT"
        mode := try parse_mode(words[2])
        if op == "DOT"
            separator := 3
            while words[separator] != "|"
                separator += 1
            left := try operands(fmt, words[3:<separator])
            right := try operands(fmt, words[separator + 1:])
            try dot_product(fmt, mode, left, right)
        else
            patterns := try operands(fmt, words[3:])
            try summation(op, fmt, mode, patterns)
    elif op == "TABLE"
        try table_output(fmt)
    elif op == "ADD" or op == "SUB" or op == "MUL" or op == "DIV" or op == "SQRT" or op == "FMA"
        count := if op == "SQRT" then 1 elif op == "FMA" then 3 else 2
        patterns := try operands(fmt, words[2:<2 + count])
        mode := try optional_mode(words, 2 + count)
        emit("{op} {name} {mode_text(mode)} " + result_text(fmt, operation(fmt, op, patterns, mode)))
    else
        pattern := try operand(fmt, words[2])
        parts := decode_fields(fmt, pattern)
        if op == "DECODE"
            classification := if is_nan(fmt, pattern) then (if is_signaling(fmt, pattern) then "snan" else "qnan") elif is_infinity(fmt, pattern) then "infinity" elif is_zero(fmt, pattern) then "zero" elif parts.exponent == 0 then "subnormal" else "normal"
            sign := if parts.negative then 1 else 0
            emit("DECODE {name} {bit_text(fmt, pattern)} {hex_text(fmt, pattern)} {classification} sign={sign}")
            text := "FIELDS exponent={parts.exponent} fraction={parts.fraction}"
            if is_finite(fmt, pattern)
                leading := if parts.exponent == 0 then 0 else 1
                emit(text + " unbiased={parts.q + fmt.m} significand={leading}." + radix_text(parts.fraction, 2, fmt.m))
                emit("VALUE {fraction_text(from_pattern(fmt, pattern))} {value_text(fmt, pattern)}")
            else
                if is_nan(fmt, pattern)
                    text += " payload={parts.fraction % (fmt.hidden / 2)}"
                emit(text)
        elif op == "COMPARE"
            other := try operand(fmt, words[3])
            total_order := relation(order_key(fmt, pattern), order_key(fmt, other))
            numeric := if is_nan(fmt, pattern) or is_nan(fmt, other) then "UN" elif is_zero(fmt, pattern) and is_zero(fmt, other) then "EQ" else total_order
            flags := Flags(invalid = is_signaling(fmt, pattern) or is_signaling(fmt, other))
            emit("COMPARE {name} {hex_text(fmt, pattern)} {hex_text(fmt, other)} {numeric} total={total_order} {flag_text(flags)}")
        elif op == "TOINT"
            limits := try integer_limits(words[3])
            mode := try optional_mode(words, 4)
            prefix := "TOINT {name} {words[3]} {mode_text(mode)}"
            if not is_finite(fmt, pattern)
                emit(prefix + " invalid flags=invalid")
            else
                units := round_units(from_pattern(fmt, pattern), 0, mode)
                integer := if parts.negative then -units.value else units.value
                if integer < limits.minimum or integer > limits.maximum
                    emit(prefix + " invalid flags=invalid")
                else
                    emit(prefix + " {integer} " + flag_text(Flags(inexact = units.inexact)))
        else
            Result result
            if is_nan(fmt, pattern)
                result = Result(fmt.nan_pattern, Flags(invalid = is_signaling(fmt, pattern)))
            elif op == "NEXTUP"
                result = Result(next_up(fmt, pattern))
            elif op == "NEXTDOWN"
                result = Result(flip(fmt, next_up(fmt, flip(fmt, pattern))))
            elif is_infinity(fmt, pattern)
                result = Result(fmt.infinity)
            else
                result = Result(rounded(fmt, Exact(1, parts.q), Mode.RNE).pattern)
            emit("{op} {name} " + result_text(fmt, result))
    return void

map<string, Format> known_formats
.known_formats.set("HALF", Format("HALF", 5, 10))
.known_formats.set("E5M2", Format("E5M2", 5, 2))
.known_formats.set("E4M3", Format("E4M3", 4, 3))
string count_line
scan(&count_line)
command_count := int(count_line)
for: 0 <= command_number < command_count
    string line
    scan(&line)
    void | error outcome := command(&known_formats, line.split(" "))
    match outcome
        void
            continue
        error problem
            emit("ERROR " + problem.message)
